name: Trade Freedom: Wallet, deposit, withdraw, transfer, swap pages

planSteps.description: Login with email superadmin@local.com and password password at https://demo2.tradefreedoms.com/login
Login successful, redirected to main page
Wallet page shows balance cards for different wallet types (funding, trading, futures, stocks, mining)
Deposit page shows deposit methods with QR code or address and coin selection
Withdraw page shows withdraw form with amount and address fields
Transfer page shows wallet balances and direction selector (funding-to-trading or trading-to-funding)
Swap page shows token swap interface with from/to fields
